bio.text: According to his campaign, Zach Dembo is a Democratic candidate for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District who was raised in Lexington, where he lives.
According to his campaign, he attended Stanford University, taught eighth-grade English in the Mississippi Delta through Teach For America, and earned a law degree at the University of Michigan.

His campaign says he served over four years on active duty as a Navy Judge Advocate General officer, became a Justice Department Civil Rights Division prosecutor in 2017, and in 2020 was appointed a policy advisor to Gov. Andy Beshear.
His campaign says he later returned to federal prosecution as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Lexington before resigning from the Justice Department.

sources.title: RELEASE: Navy Veteran & Former Federal Prosecutor Zach Dembo Announces Campaign for KY-06
